messages:
Evelyn: Heads up team 4-seat cross-regional beta (EMEA + NA) scheduled 6/21-6/23. Main goals: smooth SSO, language support for prompts, and early renewal signal capture. Need owners for: localized invite copy, kickoff cadence, translation of quickstart, and a churn nudge strategy if uptake is low.

Marc: I can do localized invites (EN/FR/DE). Quick Q: do we have translated legal consent text or shall I use English plus a parenthetical?

Olga: Ill own quickstart translation and TL;DR guides. Goal: 1-pager per locale (EN/FR/DE) with screenshots. Will need the final UI strings by Friday.

Ravi: I'll run the kickoff demos and tech deep-dive for infra-heavy customers. Propose 25m demo + 15m triage slot for SSO/API issues. Also can record a short demo for on-demand playback. :movie_camera: 

Cass: UX note  we should surface an in-product "preview tour" link in the invite so customers can try a constrained flow before kickoff. Lower friction -> better demo completion rates.

Evelyn: Good. For churn/renewal nudge: propose a two-step path: 1) automated email + in-product nudge at 7 days if low engagement, 2) AM outreach + 15% pilot discount if still low at 14 days and we identify integration blocker. Any legal issues with discount?

Marc: Discount ok but need finance signoff. I'll loop in pricing. For consent text, legal prefers translated blurbs when possible; use English fallback with parenthetical translation.

Olga: Translation plan: Ill produce drafts by Thu COB. Can we get the sample prompts & screenshots from product today?

Ravi: Sharing a small script for automated sample query run we want customers to execute pre-kickoff to validate pipeline:
```
# sample query check
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/query -H "Authorization: Bearer <preview_key>" -d '{"input":"sample test prompt","max_tokens":40}'
```
Share results as screenshot or paste snippet into the intake form.

Cass: I'll add the in-product tour link to the invite templates and make the tour auto-expand for preview cohorts.

Evelyn: Survey plan: very short + multilingual. Qs: 1) Demo usefulness (1-5), 2) Biggest blocker (free text), 3) Interest in pilot discount (Yes/No). Link: https://forms.gle/preview-x-regional-feedback

Marc: Also propose a quick health score: Demo attended (Y/N), Tour completed (Y/N), Sample query success (Y/N), Survey avg >=4 (Y/N) -> green if all yes, amber if one no, red if two or more no. We can map to SFDC field preview_health.

Olga: Ill translate the survey text after Marc finalizes. Will reuse the drive folder: https://drive.redwood/preview-x-assets

Ravi: Ops-bot: created calendar block for kickoffs 6/21-6/23 (8 slots). I'll include recorded link as backup for folks in APAC who can't attend live.

Cass: Also prepping a short "first-week playbook" for AMs: day 1 kickoff, day 3 check-in, day 7 automated nudge, day 14 manual risk triage. Will post in /playbooks/preview-first-week.

Evelyn: Nice. Legal/Finance ask: Marc pls confirm discount approval path by Thurs AM. Cass pls make the playbook include the wording for outreach + discount offer template. Olga pls finish translations by Thu COB. Ravi pls record the demo and post link.

reminders-bot: Reminder set: finalize invites/consent/discount by 6/17 10:00 PT.

Evelyn: Thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 9:00 PT to confirm localized invites and playbook. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :sparkles:
